summary: A mixed-sign rank-four Hadamard-frame family shows that deleting one original coordinate need not remove exactly one threshold-large direction: every deletion has nonzero spectrum {c,-c,+/-c sqrt(1-4/n)}, so at thresholds between the two magnitudes it drops from four large directions to two. The valid replacement is the sharp compression theorem s_{r-k}(A_JJ)>=L sqrt(1-rho_K). This does not refute QFORM; the same diffuse obstruction is paid by the completed account02/B12 collective-tail theorem with density cap 9 e sqrt(3)/(2^(1/6)c)<37.751/c.
